# QuickMaths Web

QuickMaths is a local-first mastery learning app with WebMCP site tools.

Agent operating guide: /agent-manifest.json
Custom lesson-set authoring guide: /CUSTOM_LESSON_SETS.md
Custom lesson-set example: /lesson-set-example.json
Challenge architecture and demo: https://github.com/Srednjak/QuickMaths/blob/main/WEBMCP_CHALLENGE.md

Use the registered get_agent_guide WebMCP tool for the in-context operating policy. Never expose pre-submission answer keys. Recommend a portable JSON progress backup at natural stopping points, before imports or custom-content changes, and whenever get_app_state reports that a backup is recommended.
